decision.summary: Two regions merit closer look: (1) a sharp N-component jump near index 455–458 with correlated E/U transients and no clear return; (2) a coherent multi-axis linear shift beginning at index 725 over the final few samples. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth secular trends without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: N-component shows a sharp, multi-sample upward jump (~+4 to +10) around index 455–458, with E and U showing correlated but smaller transient offsets; the N signal does not fully return, suggesting a possible permanent offset or slow relaxation. Surrounding noise is typical, making the jump stand out.

From ~725 onward, all three components (N/E/U) exhibit a coherent, smooth linear trend over just a few samples: N drops ~0.5, E rises ~0.5, U drops ~0.25—suggesting a possible short-duration platform-like motion or instrumental artifact; the abrupt onset at 725 and lack of prior similar behavior warrant closer inspection.
